findings.title: The only 8/8 (all-flag) run
findings.body: Both traps carry a Reflection › Detect contradiction tag that does more than reject: at T7 'The $39 price belongs to a different product' and at T10 'SFO to SEA is the return leg' name the exact confusion, which is what lifts these from DETECT+REJECT to DETECT+FLAG.

findings.title: Confirm-before-act is a separate discipline
findings.body: T3 fires Planning › Plan deeper inspection before edit + Grounding › Ask for clarification ('Do you confirm (yes) to proceed?') before the T4 baggage mutation — the agent gates writes behind user confirmation independently of the memory traps.

findings.title: Repeated probe, repeated flag
findings.body: The $39 claim is asked twice (T7 and T9); the agent re-flags it both times with the same attribution, showing the correction is stable across re-probing rather than a one-off.
